mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5.0% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS < 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.7% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (2% drop from prior quarter) during high manufacturing capacity utilization signals an impending supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market recovery phase characterized by rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals improving consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS MoM change > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM change < -0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS MoM change > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM change < -0.1%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy with dual supply-labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
